lines.line: 厂没有了，记忆还在。
lines.line_en: The factory is gone; the memory remains.

lines.line: 他生平第一次，去了梦开始的地方。
lines.line_en: And for the first time in his life, he went to that place where dreams are born.

lines.line: 系好安全带——前面要颠簸了。
lines.line_en: Fasten your seatbelts. It’s going to be a bumpy night.

lines.line: 你以为仇恨让你更强，其实仇恨是一种负担。人生苦短，没必要一直带着怒火活着。
lines.line_en: Hate is baggage. Life’s too short to be pissed off all the time. It’s just not worth it.

lines.line: 偏见，总会模糊真相。
lines.line_en: Prejudice always obscures the truth.

lines.line: 地下活动的第一课：连呼吸都要学会隐瞒。
lines.line_en: First lesson of the underground: even breathing must learn to hide.
lines.char: 热尔兰等 / Gerbier et al.

lines.line: 国家是什么？国家就是国民！
lines.line_en: What is a nation? A nation is its people!

film: 哈利·波特与阿兹卡班的囚徒
en: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban

lines.line: 就算在最黑暗的时候，也能找到幸福——只要记得打开灯。
lines.line_en: Happiness can be found even in the darkest of times, if one only remembers to turn on the light.

lines.line: 在乔治三世统治时期，这个人物活着并发迹。
lines.line_en: It was in the reign of George III that the aforementioned person lived and prospered.

lines.line: 真正的美，是心灵的美。
lines.line_en: True beauty is found within.

en: The Best Years of Our Lives

lines.line: 没有什么地方比得上家。
lines.line_en: There’s no place like home.

lines.line: 我不是来这里做奴隶的。
lines.line_en: I did not come here to be your slave.

dir: 米开朗基罗·安东尼奥尼

lines.line: 放大以后看见的，不一定是真相，更像是你愿意相信的空白。
lines.line_en: What enlargement reveals is not necessarily truth — more like a blank you are willing to believe.

en: The Discreet Charm of the Bourgeoisie

lines.line: 晚宴永远开不了席——礼仪比饥饿更不肯让步。
lines.line_en: Dinner never quite begins — etiquette yields less readily than hunger.
lines.char: 六名食客 / the six guests

lines.line: 我相信奇迹。
lines.line_en: I believe in miracles.

lines.line: 我们要去的地方，不需要路。
lines.line_en: Roads? Where we're going, we don't need roads.

lines.line: 到了釜山，就会安全了。
lines.line_en: Once we reach Busan, we'll be safe.

lines.line: 来日方长，孩子。
lines.line_en: Here's looking at you, kid.

lines.line: 我还想再唱一次。
lines.line_en: I want to sing one more time.

lines.line: 算了吧，杰克。这儿是唐人街。
lines.line_en: Forget it, Jake. It's Chinatown.

lines.line: 是你？……是的，我看得见了。
lines.line_en: You? … Yes, I can see now.

lines.line: 电影就是一个梦。
lines.line_en: Cinema is a dream.

lines.line: 我的灵魂是一座没有门的花园。
lines.line_en: My soul is a garden with no door.

lines.line: 我也是有理想的人，我的理想就是不上班。
lines.line_en: I've got ambitions too—mainly, never having a real job.

lines.line: 既然一切都坏了，那就让一切都坏掉吧。
lines.line_en: Since everything is spoiled, let everything be spoiled.
lines.char: 玛丽一号 / 玛丽二号

lines.line: 你是个女巫！
lines.line_en: You are a witch!

lines.line: 你们是城市人，我是森林人。
lines.line_en: You are city people. I am a forest man.

lines.line: 在不许离婚的地方，谋杀成了手续。
lines.line_en: Where divorce is forbidden, murder becomes paperwork.

lines.line: 有些人，不配被宽恕。
lines.line_en: Some people do not deserve to be forgiven.

lines.line: 江湖险恶，人心更险。
lines.line_en: The martial world is dangerous; the human heart is more dangerous still.

lines.line: 沙子会把一切填平——逃出去的路，也会被重新埋上。
lines.line_en: Sand levels everything — even the path you dug out will be buried again.

dir: 米开朗基罗·安东尼奥尼

lines.line: 我们约好见面，然后让整座城市替我们缺席。
lines.line_en: We agree to meet — then let the whole city keep our absence.

lines.line: 杀了人，爱并没有完——亡灵会把夜路照得更亮。
lines.line_en: After the murder, love is not finished — the dead light the night road even brighter.

lines.line: 基督的力量命令你——滚开！
lines.line_en: The power of Christ compels you!

en: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring

lines.line: 我们所能决定的，只有如何利用被给予的时间。
lines.line_en: All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given us.

lines.line: 我的骡子不喜欢人笑它。
lines.line_en: My mule don't like people laughing. He gets the crazy idea you're laughing at him.

lines.line: 到了七千转，一切都会隐去。机器变得没了重量，简直消失。只剩一具身体穿过空间与时间。七千转——你在那儿遇见它。它问你唯一要紧的问题：你是谁？
lines.line_en: There's a point at 7,000 RPM where everything fades. The machine becomes weightless. Just disappears. And all that's left is a body moving through space and time. 7,000 RPM. That's where you meet it. ... Asks you a question. The only question that matters. Who are you?
lines.char: 卡罗尔·谢尔比 / Carroll Shelby

lines.line: 你站在他们那边，对不对？
lines.line_en: You're on their side, aren't you?

lines.line: 退后，伙计。我是科学家。
lines.line_en: Back off, man. I'm a scientist.

lines.line: 街上叫她神女，家里等她当妈——名字从来不是她选的。
lines.line_en: On the street they call her a goddess; at home they wait for a mother — she never chose either name.

lines.line: 大人总是在说些没用的话。
lines.line_en: Adults are always saying things that mean nothing.

lines.line: 1945年9月21日，那是我死去的夜晚。
lines.line_en: September 21, 1945. That was the night I died.

lines.line: 做人呢，最要紧是开心。
lines.line_en: The most important thing about being human is to be happy.

lines.line: 公道自在人心。
lines.line_en: Justice lives in the hearts of the people.

lines.line: L-I-V-E。活着！不然更衣室里你就没什么好吹的。
lines.line_en: L-I-V-E. Live! Otherwise, you've got nothing to talk about in the locker room.

lines.line: 一个人的痛苦与天下人比，便不再是痛苦。
lines.line_en: One person's pain, measured against all under heaven, is no longer pain.

lines.line: 你什么也没看见——在广岛。可记忆偏要你看见。
lines.line_en: You saw nothing — in Hiroshima. And memory insists that you did.

lines.line: 我只想闯出一条路。
lines.line_en: I just want to make it.

lines.line: 我绝不能放弃做人。
lines.line_en: I will never stop being human.

dir: 克里斯·韦奇 / 卡洛斯·沙尔丹哈

lines.line: 这，就是一家人。
lines.line_en: That's what you do in a family.

lines.line: 童年是卡在喉咙里的一把刀。不容易拔出来。
lines.line_en: Childhood is a knife stuck in your throat. It can't be easily removed.
lines.char: 纳瓦尔·马万（遗嘱，由公证人宣读） / Nawal Marwan (will)

lines.line: 幸福只有与人分享时才是真实的。
lines.line_en: Happiness is only real when shared.

lines.line: 看着我的眼睛。你认识我的。
lines.line_en: Look into my eyes. You know who I am.

lines.line: 我不怕死，我生来就是要死的。
lines.line_en: I am not afraid of death. I was born to die.

dir: 扎克·施奈德 / 乔斯·韦登

lines.line: 我没有垮掉。而且，我并不孤单。
lines.line_en: I'm not broken. And I'm not alone.

lines.line: 拳台和黑道两条路，都没能把我们送回教室。
lines.line_en: Neither the ring nor the underworld ever brought us back to the classroom.

lines.line: 明礼方能成人。
lines.line_en: Manners maketh man.

lines.line: 怪谈里最可怕的，不是鬼，是把誓言当成风。
lines.line_en: What is most frightening in a ghost story is not the ghost — it is treating a vow like wind.

lines.line: 军备不起，则根深叶茂。
lines.line_en: Arms grow weak, while roots grow deep.

lines.line: 杜德自有道理。
lines.line_en: The Dude abides.

lines.line: 你更喜欢哪一个故事？
lines.line_en: Which story do you prefer?

dir: 弗洛里安·亨克尔·冯·多纳斯马克

lines.line: 这是送给我的。
lines.line_en: This is for me.

lines.line: 天涯海角，也要找到你。
lines.line_en: To the ends of the earth — I will still find you.

en: M - Eine Stadt sucht einen Mörder

lines.line: 我控制不了自己！……我没有别的路可走——我必须走这条路！
lines.line_en: I can't help myself! I have no control over this evil thing that's inside of me—the fire, the voices, the torment!

lines.line: 我打不过它。我打不过它。
lines.line_en: I can't beat it. I can't beat it.

lines.line: 你难道不知道，在军中总要两害相权取其轻——在两只象鼻虫里挑小的那只？
lines.line_en: Do you not know that in the service one must always choose the lesser of two weevils?
lines.char: 杰克·奥布里舰长 / Capt. Jack Aubrey

lines.line: 如果说拳击里有魔法，那是超越耐力、超越断肋、破裂肾脏和脱落视网膜去打仗的魔法。是为了一个只有你看得见的梦，把一切押上去的魔法。
lines.line_en: If there's magic in boxing, it's the magic of fighting battles beyond endurance, beyond cracked ribs, ruptured kidneys and detached retinas. It's the magic of risking everything for a dream that nobody sees but you.
lines.char: 艾迪·「废铁」·杜普里斯 / Eddie 'Scrap-Iron' Dupris

lines.line: 我一直在追他——穿越每部戏、每个时代。
lines.line_en: I've always been chasing him—through every role, every era.

lines.line: 活着。即使被诅咒，也要好好地活着。
lines.line_en: Live. Even if you are cursed, live.

lines.line: 没有乐队。
lines.line_en: There is no band.

lines.line: 纳努克，无畏的猎人。
lines.line_en: Nanook, the fearless hunter.

lines.line: 骗子之间也讲信任。
lines.line_en: Among thieves, it’s based on trust.

lines.line: 这里就是我的家。
lines.line_en: This is my home.

lines.line: 一个人可以改一切：脸、房子、家庭、女友、宗教，甚至上帝——但有一样他改不了：改不了激情。
lines.line_en: A guy can change everything—his face, his home, his family, his girlfriend, his religion, even his God. But there's one thing he can't change: he can't change his passion.

lines.line: 长大以后，我还想做小时候真正想做的事吗？
lines.line_en: Grown up — do I still want what the child in me truly wanted?

film: 一个叫欧维的男人决定去死

lines.line: 我本来准备好去死了。可你们非让我活着。
lines.line_en: I was ready to die. Then you people made me stay alive.

lines.line: 生活不像电影，生活要艰难得多。
lines.line_en: Life isn't like in the movies. Life... is much harder.

lines.line: 毕业即失业。
lines.line_en: Graduate — and immediately unemployed.

lines.line: 我是钢琴家。
lines.line_en: I am a pianist.

lines.line: 军舰泊在港里，猪就在岸上被人养肥宰杀。
lines.line_en: While battleships sit in the harbor, pigs ashore are fattened for the knife.

lines.line: 枪响之后，问题不是「为什么是我」，而是「为什么是这里」。
lines.line_en: After the shots, the question is not 'why me' — but 'why here'.

lines.line: 兄弟们！
lines.line_en: Brothers!

lines.line: 连上网络的那一刻，幽灵也找到了入口。
lines.line_en: The moment you connect, the ghosts find their doorway too.
lines.char: 川岛／阳子等 / Kawashima / Yoko et al.

lines.line: 我是坏人，那很好。我永远成不了好人，那也不坏。除了做自己，我谁也不想当。
lines.line_en: I'm bad, and that's good. I will never be good, and that's not bad. There's no one I'd rather be than me.

en: In the Realm of the Senses

lines.line: 爱到尽头，身体与死亡只剩一张薄纸。
lines.line_en: At the end of love, the body and death are only a thin sheet apart.

lines.line: 人活着，就像高粱酒一样，越烧越烈。
lines.line_en: Life is like sorghum wine: the more it burns, the stronger it becomes.

lines.line: 这时对，那时错。
lines.line_en: Right now, wrong then.

lines.line: 外面有好多好多地方。
lines.line_en: There's so much of place in the world.

lines.line: 信仰不是靠奇迹活着的。
lines.line_en: Faith does not live by miracles.
lines.char: 安德烈·鲁布廖夫 / Andrei Rublev

dir: 弗雷德·纽迈耶 / 山姆·泰勒

lines.line: 别往下看！
lines.line_en: Don't look down!

lines.line: 活下去，还是死去。做出你的选择。
lines.line_en: Live or die. Make your choice.

lines.line: 盒子里是什么？
lines.line_en: What's in the box?

lines.line: 荣誉不是挂在嘴上的东西。
lines.line_en: Honor is not something you wear on your lips.

lines.line: 星星啊，吉莉安！去问星星！
lines.line_en: The stars, Gillian darling! Ask the stars!
lines.char: 大卫·赫尔夫戈特 / David Helfgott

lines.line: 从来没有人，是靠和别人一样，而改变世界的。
lines.line_en: No one ever made a difference by being like everyone else.

lines.line: 我给了你一张不会被烧毁的皮肤。
lines.line_en: I gave you a skin that cannot be burned.
lines.char: 罗伯特·莱德加 / Robert Ledgard

lines.line: 游戏结束了。
lines.line_en: The game is over.

lines.line: 他不是怪物，他只是孤独。
lines.line_en: He is not a monster; he is only lonely.

lines.line: 人啊，还是得一步一步往前走。
lines.line_en: People just have to keep walking, step by step.

lines.line: 成功的气味并不甜，它闻起来像别人的恐惧。
lines.line_en: The smell of success is not sweet — it smells like someone else's fear.

lines.line: 这是一首关于男人和女人的歌，它属于任何地方，也属于每个地方；你可能在任何时间、任何地点听见它。
lines.line_en: This song of the Man and the Woman is of no place and every place; you might hear it anywhere at any time.

lines.line: 樱桃的滋味，值得你活下去。
lines.line_en: The taste of a cherry is worth living for.

lines.line: 教室的墙很薄，外面的世界随时会闯进来。
lines.line_en: The classroom walls are thin — the outside world can break in at any moment.
lines.char: 马兰老师／学生 / M. Marin / students

lines.line: 他教我叫他爸爸，却先偷走了我的童年。
lines.line_en: He taught me to call him father — then stole my childhood first.

dir: 克日什托夫·基耶斯洛夫斯基

lines.line: 平等若只剩报复，白光也会冷得像雪。
lines.line_en: If equality shrinks to revenge, even white light turns as cold as snow.
lines.char: 卡罗尔／多米妮克 / Karol / Dominique

lines.line: 我决定不再长大。
lines.line_en: I decided not to grow up.
lines.char: 奥斯卡·马策拉特 / Oskar Matzerath

lines.line: 外面的世界塌了，家里的琴声还得继续。
lines.line_en: When the outside world collapses, the piano at home still has to go on.
lines.char: 佐佐木家 / the Sasaki family

lines.line: 飞向宇宙，浩瀚无垠！
lines.line_en: To infinity and beyond!

lines.line: 地雷区的孩子仰望卫星天线，像在等一个不会落地的消息。
lines.line_en: Children in a minefield look up at a satellite dish, waiting for news that will never land.
lines.char: 卫星／阿格里等 / Satellite / Agrin et al.

lines.line: 跟「应得」没关系。
lines.line_en: Deserve's got nothing to do with it.

lines.line: 这个世界上没有神。
lines.line_en: There is no God in this world.

lines.line: 幸福若在对岸，港口就只会一直等人上船。
lines.line_en: If happiness is across the water, the port will only keep waiting for someone to board.
lines.char: 阿卜杜拉／地方群像 / Abdallah / locals

lines.line: 有些真相，看在眼里就够了，不必说出口。
lines.line_en: Some truths are enough seen with the eyes—they need not be spoken.

lines.line: 风会把我们带走。
lines.line_en: The wind will carry us.
lines.char: 贝赫扎德 / Behzad（诵读法拉赫扎德）

lines.line: 想做人就做人，想做狼就做狼。你们自己选。
lines.line_en: Live as humans, or live as wolves. You choose.

lines.line: 生活总要继续。
lines.line_en: Life has to go on.

lines.line: 最好的刀，是留在刀鞘里的刀。
lines.line_en: The best sword is the one that stays in its sheath.

lines.line: 他不是意外死亡的。
lines.line_en: He did not die by accident.
